name: Vidyard
description: Vidyard is a business video platform for recording, hosting, sharing, and measuring video content. Teams use it for personalized sales videos, customer communication, video libraries, embedded players, captions, analytics, and interactive experiences.
agentUseSummary: Enter a role- and folder-bound API token from the customer's own Vidyard account, then let agents manage the complete documented Dashboard API under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: VIDYARD_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Vidyard API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy a dedicated role-bound token under Admin > API Tokens in the intended Vidyard folder.

capabilities.label: Read video library
capabilities.description: List and inspect permitted players, videos, captions, tags, accounts, and related metadata.

capabilities.label: Maintain video content
capabilities.description: Create, update, duplicate, publish, organize, and delete permitted video resources.

capabilities.label: Use analytics and events
capabilities.description: Read permitted analytics events and manage analytics subscriptions and player webhooks.

capabilities.label: Administer Vidyard
capabilities.description: Use all other documented Dashboard API resources permitted by the token's folder and role.

allowed.label: List accounts
allowed.description: List accounts visible to the configured token.

allowed.label: List players
allowed.description: List one bounded page of players in the configured folder.

allowed.label: Read player
allowed.description: Read one player by ID or UUID.

allowed.label: List videos
allowed.description: List one bounded page of videos in the configured folder.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Dashboard API
approvalRequired.description: Use any current documented Dashboard API operation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded account, player, and video reads run directly; every other Dashboard API operation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected token-authorized Dashboard API operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, fixed origin, bounds, audits, redaction, token role and folder permissions, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected Vidyard tools through the authenticated server-side connector.
Railway mounts selected Vidyard tools through the authenticated server-side connector.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer Vidyard API token or eligible signed-in provider session is available for production acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer admin creates a dedicated role-bound token in the intended folder, connects it in Relay Console, then runs health, bounded reads, Safe denial, approved or Dangerous mutation, redaction, revocation, and disconnect checks.

evidence.supports: Vidyard documents customer API tokens under Admin > API Tokens, permission-gated visibility, role-bound authority, and use with the Dashboard API and analytics webhooks.
The Dashboard API programmatically manages videos, players, tags, and metadata with CRUD operations; tokens are unique to a folder and inherit the selected role's permissions.
The current official reference documents Dashboard v1 resources including accounts, organizations, players, videos, captions, tags, users, teams, events, and webhooks authenticated with auth_token.
